collection.title: VW Beetle Hatchback 2005 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Beetle 2005 to 2010 model requires a 21" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
